changeSet.author: antigravity
changeSet.comment: Create UNIPOST_TENANTS master table, backfill from workspaces/billing, and link FK
changeSet.sql:
-- Seed SYSTEM root custodian tenant if missing INSERT INTO UNIPOST_TENANTS (uid, code, name, status, plan_tier) VALUES ('tenant-root-system', 'SYSTEM', 'Sovereign Root Platform', 'ACTIVE', 'ENTERPRISE') ON CONFLICT (code) DO NOTHING;
-- Backfill distinct tenants from UNIPOST_WORKSPACES INSERT INTO UNIPOST_TENANTS (uid, code, name, status, plan_tier) SELECT 'tenant-' || substr(md5(random()::text), 1, 16), w.tenant_id, INITCAP(REPLACE(w.tenant_id, '-', ' ')) || ' Org', 'ACTIVE', COALESCE(b.plan_tier, 'BASIC') FROM (SELECT DISTINCT tenant_id FROM UNIPOST_WORKSPACES WHERE tenant_id IS NOT NULL) w LEFT JOIN UNIPOST_TENANT_BILLING b ON b.tenant_id = w.tenant_id WHERE w.tenant_id != 'SYSTEM' ON CONFLICT (code) DO NOTHING;
